body:
WHAT
One object, the BackgroundManager, owns every job that runs outside the current turn: backgrounded Bash commands, Monitors and background Agents. Each job gets an id like bash_1a2b3c4d, an output file under .magentra/tasks/<id>.output, and a status (running, completed, failed, stopped). When a job exits, the manager emits one background_notification event and queues one <task-notification> reminder for the model's next turn.

WHY
Without a single owner, a finished job could be reported twice, or a stopped job could look alive forever in the UI, and TaskStop/TaskOutput would have no shared place to look ids up.

WHERE
engine/core/src/scheduling/background.ts — class BackgroundManager: launch() (creates id + output file, emits kind:'start', wraps onExit so it only fires while status is 'running'), get(), list(), stop() (sets status 'stopped', calls the handle's stop, emits kind:'exit' with stopped:true), stopAll(). Interfaces BackgroundApi and BackgroundTaskInfo live in engine/core/src/agent/tool.ts. Wired in engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts (new BackgroundManager(this.stateDir, this.emit, remind)).

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With a temp stateDir, launch() a fake job whose start() captures onExit; assert the returned info has status 'running', an id prefixed by the kind, and outputFile under <stateDir>/tasks/, and that a background_notification with kind 'start' was emitted.
2. Call the captured onExit(0) twice; assert exactly one 'exit' background_notification and exactly one remind() call containing '<task-notification>' and the id, and that status is 'completed' with exitCode 0.
3. Call onExit(3) once; assert status 'failed' and exitCode 3; call onExit(null) on another job and assert exitCode -1.
4. Call stop(id) on a running job; assert it returns true, the handle's stop() ran, status is 'stopped', an 'exit' notification with payload.stopped:true was emitted, and a later onExit() from the child emits nothing and calls remind() zero times.
5. Call stop() on an unknown id and again on an already-stopped id; assert both return false and emit no event; stopAll() with two running jobs stops both.
